### FederationPeer

A remote instance this repository pulls changes from. Secrets (token, client key) are never returned; has_ca_pem and has_client_cert tell whether TLS material is stored.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `applied_total` | integer (int64) | yes | Units applied from this peer since the peer was added. |
| `backlog_units` | integer (int64) | yes | Logged units still to apply. |
| `base_url` | string | yes | Base URL of the peer instance. |
| `conflicts_total` | integer (int64) | yes | Units that conflicted with local content and were resolved by the merge rules. |
| `created_at` | string (date-time) | yes | - |
| `cursor_seq` | integer (int64) | yes | Last peer log sequence applied locally. |
| `deferred_units` | integer | yes | Units waiting for a dependency or a retry. |
| `enabled` | boolean | yes | A disabled peer is not polled. |
| `error_count` | integer | yes | Consecutive failed attempts. |
| `has_ca_pem` | boolean | yes | - |
| `has_client_cert` | boolean | yes | - |
| `id` | string (uuid) | yes | - |
| `lag_seconds` | number | yes | Age in seconds of the oldest unapplied change; 0 when caught up. |
| `last_attempt_at` | string (date-time) | no | - |
| `last_error` | string | yes | Error of the last failed attempt; empty when the last attempt succeeded. |
| `last_success_at` | string (date-time) | no | - |
| `name` | string | yes | - |
| `next_attempt_at` | string (date-time) | no | - |
| `remote_head_seq` | integer (int64) | yes | Peer's log head sequence as of the last successful contact. |
| `resync_requested` | boolean | yes | A resync is queued and not yet started. |
| `state` | string | yes | ok: caught up. lagging: behind the peer's head. error: the last attempt failed. pending: never synced yet. disabled: not polled. One of: `ok`, `lagging`, `error`, `pending`, `disabled`. |

### LicenseBlockedError

Upload rejected by a license policy with action `block`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | yes | One of: `LICENSE_BLOCKED`. |
| `error` | string | yes | - |
| `licenses` | array of string | yes | The package's detected licenses. |
| `policies` | array of [LicensePolicyViolation](#licensepolicyviolation) | yes | - |

### LicenseMetadataUnreadableError

Upload rejected (422): the repository has an enabled license policy with action `block` and the package's license cannot be derived from the package file (a file type without readable metadata, a damaged archive), so only the client's own claims would decide the policy.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | yes | One of: `LICENSE_METADATA_UNREADABLE`. |
| `error` | string | yes | - |

### LicenseMetadataUnsafeError

Upload rejected (422): the package file's own metadata is oversized or ambiguous (a decompression bomb, or two candidate metadata files), so its licenses cannot be checked.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | yes | One of: `LICENSE_METADATA_UNSAFE`. |
| `error` | string | yes | - |

### LicenseScanResult

Result of one license scan of an artifact.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `id` | string (uuid) | yes | - |
| `license_source` | string | no | `artifact`: the licenses include ones read from the stored package file. `client_declared`: they only come from what a client declared (license properties) because the file declares no license, or cannot be read and no blocking policy applies. | `quarantine_approved` | boolean | yes | An admin approved the artifact for its current licenses; cleared when a re-scan finds different licenses. |

| `scan_error` | string | yes | Nullable. |
| `scan_status` | string | yes | One of: `pending`, `completed`, `failed`. |

| `spdx_expressions` | array of string | no | - |
| `unresolved_licenses` | array of string | no | Entries of licenses that are not SPDX expressions: raw text read from the artifact ("BSD", "BSD License"), kept as written and flagged for review. |

### OIDCConfig

OIDC/OAuth 2.0 provider settings. client_secret is write-only: responses carry has_secret instead.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `allowed_orgs` | array of string | no | type github: organizations whose members may sign in (required). Groups are "org" and "org/team-slug", lower-case. |
| `allowed_tenants` | array of string | no | Entra tenant IDs (GUIDs) allowed to sign in. Required for multi-tenant authorities. |
| `api_base_url` | string | no | type github: API base URL (default https://api.github.com). |
| `auth_base_url` | string | no | type github: base URL of GitHub Enterprise Server (default https://github.com). |
| `authorization_url` | string | no | type oauth2: authorization endpoint. |
| `client_id` | string | no | - |
| `client_secret` | string | no | - |
| `email_claim` | string | no | - |
| `graph_endpoint` | string | no | Microsoft Graph base URL (default https://graph.microsoft.com). |
| `graph_groups` | boolean | no | Resolve Entra groups overage through Microsoft Graph (needs a delegated User.Read access token; group_mapping keys are group object IDs). |
| `groups_claim` | string | no | - |
| `has_secret` | boolean | no | - |
| `hosted_domain` | string | no | Google Workspace domain: sent as the hd authorization parameter and required in the hd claim. |
| `issuer` | string | no | Issuer URL (required for type ""). https://accounts.google.com enforces email_verified; https://login.microsoftonline.com/{common\|organizations\|consumers}/v2.0 is a multi-tenant Entra authority and requires allowed_tenants. |
| `name_claim` | string | no | - |
| `require_email_verified` | boolean | no | Deny logins whose email is not verified by the IdP (always on for Google). |
| `scopes` | array of string | no | Default: openid email profile (github: read:user user:email read:org). Request groups explicitly if the IdP needs it. |
| `token_url` | string | no | type oauth2: token endpoint. |
| `type` | string | no | Empty: standards-compliant OIDC (issuer discovery). github: GitHub / GitHub Enterprise Server (OAuth 2.0). oauth2: generic OAuth 2.0 with a userinfo endpoint. One of: ``, `github`, `oauth2`. |
| `userinfo_url` | string | no | type oauth2: userinfo endpoint (subject is sub, else id). |
| `username_claim` | string | no | - |

### PresignedUploadRequest

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content_type` | string | no | Content type to record; detected from the content when omitted |
| `multipart` | boolean | no | Upload the object in parts: PUT each part to a URL from the parts endpoint, then call complete. Required above 5 GiB; not allowed for an empty file. |
| `part_size` | integer (int64) | no | Part size in bytes of a multipart upload (5 MiB to 4000 MiB, at most 10000 parts); the server picks one (64 MiB or more) when omitted. Minimum: 5242880. Maximum: 4194304000. |
| `path` | string | yes | Artifact path inside the repository (no empty, '.' or '..' segments) |
| `sha256` | string | yes | SHA-256 of the content; verified at completion. Pattern: `^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$`. |
| `size` | integer (int64) | yes | Exact size in bytes; signed into the upload URL. Above 5 GiB (5368709120) `multipart` must be true; the limit is 5 TiB. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 5497558138880. |

| `mismatched` | integer (int64) | no | Blobs whose two copies differ in size (or content, in a deep pass). |

| `missing_replica` | integer (int64) | no | Blobs missing from the replica (a copy was queued). |
| `repaired` | integer (int64) | no | Blobs fixed or queued for copying. |

Hosted repositories of the formats raw, maven, npm, docker, helm, pypi, cargo, go and nuget only. Peers and tokens are managed under /api/v1/repositories/{name}/federation. |
| `format` | string | yes | Package format. One of: `deb`, `rpm`, `maven`, `npm`, `docker`, `helm`, `pypi`, `nuget`, `go`, `cargo`, `rubygems`, `raw`, `conda`, `conan`, `ivy`, `sbt`. |

| `max_stale_seconds` | integer | no | Seconds past a cached file's expiry during which it may still be served, with a Warning: 110 header, when the upstream is unreachable, times out or answers 5xx. 0 disables serve-stale; default 604800 (7 days); max 31536000. |
| `member_repos` | array of string | no | Member repositories (for group repos) |
| `merge_proxy_versions` | boolean | no | Group repositories only. false (default): for a package name held by a readable hosted member, proxy members' versions of that name are hidden (hosted members win, dependency-confusion protection). true: merge proxy versions with the hosted ones. Only administrators can set it. |

| `presign_downloads` | boolean | no | Per-repository override of storage.presignDownloads: true always redirects eligible blob downloads to a presigned object-store URL, false always streams, null inherits the global setting. Metadata and manifests are never redirected. Nullable. |
| `project` | string | no | Name of the project that owns the repository (the built-in 'system' project unless set at creation or moved). Members of any other project get access to the repository according to their role; see docs/security/rbac.md. |

### VulnScanner

Whether one vulnerability scanner can run on the server. Fixed, client-safe text only.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `available` | boolean | yes | False when the `trivy` / `grype` binary is not installed or not executable. |
| `code` | string | yes | Why the scanner is not ready; null when it is. Nullable. One of: `scanner_unavailable`, `scanner_installing`, `scanner_install_failed`, `scanner_install_noexec`, `scanner_db_unavailable`. |
| `db_state` | string | yes | State of the vulnerability database of an available `trivy` / `grype`; null otherwise. Nullable. One of: `ready`, `updating`, `failed`, `missing`. |
| `db_updated_at` | string (date-time) | yes | When the vulnerability database was last refreshed; null when there is none or the time is unknown. Nullable. |
| `docs_url` | string | yes | Link to the scanner installation guide when the scanner is not ready. Nullable. |
| `install_state` | string | yes | State of the automatic installer (`scanners.<name>.install: auto`) for a `trivy` / `grype` binary that is being or was downloaded by the server; null when the binary is not managed by the installer. Nullable. One of: `installing`, `ready`, `failed`. |
| `message` | string | yes | What the operator must do when the scanner is not ready. Nullable. |
| `name` | string | yes | One of: `osv`, `trivy`, `grype`. |
| `ready` | boolean | yes | True when a scan can run now: `osv` always; `trivy` and `grype` when the binary is available and its vulnerability database is present. |
